meta.name: Ensure OCI Compute Instance boot volume has in-transit data encryption enabled
meta.description: Ensure OCI Compute Instance boot volume has in-transit data encryption enabled
meta.remediation: Set launch_options { is_pv_encryption_in_transit_enabled = true } on oci_core_instance.

evaluators.description: launch_options.0.is_pv_encryption_in_transit_enabled must be true. An absent or null launch_options block makes the indexed path a severity-2 miss, which fails at error_tolerance 1.
